name: 逻辑学家
ability: 在你的首个夜晚，你会得知三个镇民角色和一个爪牙角色，其中有且只有两个角色在场。
firstNightReminder: Wake and show 3 Townsfolk and 1 Minion, exactly 2 of which are in play

name: 风向标
ability: 在你的首个夜晚，你要选择两名玩家：当其中一名玩家死亡时，你会得知距离最近的恶魔玩家位于他的（顺时针/逆时针)方向，若恶魔的位置与他距离相等，你得知的信息由说书人决定，随后你要再选择一名玩家。
firstNightReminder: Wake the Wind Vane & show them any 3 players.
otherNightReminder: If the 2nd player the Wind Vane knows died today or tonight, wake the Wind Vane and indicate clockwise, counter-clockwise, or neither.

name: 验尸官
ability: 在你的首个夜晚，你会得知一名玩家：如果他死亡，你会得知离他最近的存活的邪恶角色。
firstNightReminder: Wake the Coroner & show them any player
otherNightReminder: If the player known by the Coroner is dead, wake them and show them an evil character token.

name: 女祭司
ability: 每个夜晚，你会得知一名说书人认为你最应该与其交流的玩家。
firstNightReminder: Wake and show which player you think they should talk to the most.
otherNightReminder: Wake and show which player you think they should talk to the most.

name: 囤积者
ability: 每个夜晚，你要选择除你以外的两名玩家。每局游戏限一次*，你可以得知你选择过的玩家共有几种角色类型，之后你不再因自身能力被唤醒。
firstNightReminder: The hoarder points to a player. Mark them with the corresponding reminder token.
otherNightReminder: The hoarder points to a player. Mark them with the corresponding reminder token if it's not already placed. They then nod or shake their head. If yes, show them a hand signal corresponding to how many character types have the "Mine" reminder token.

name: 传谕者
ability: 每个夜晚*，你要选择一名玩家：如果他当晚死亡(即使你选择了你自己)，你会得知一个在场的角色。
otherNightReminder: The Prophesier points to a player. Put them back to sleep. If that player dies later tonight, wake the Prophesier again and show thema character token.

name: 抑制者
ability: 每个夜晚*，你要选择一名死亡的玩家：当你选择第二名镇民玩家时，恶魔当晚的攻击会失效。
otherNightReminder: The Restrainer chooses a dead player.

name: 先知
ability: 每个白天，你可以私下询问说书人以得知一条信息：你得知的信息都是正确的或都是错误的。

name: 侦察兵
ability: 每个白天，你可以公开选择一名玩家：如果你首次以这种方式选中了爪牙，当晚一名善良玩家会得知此事。
otherNightReminder: If the Scout chose a Minion for the first time today, wake a good player, show them the Scout character token, then put them to sleep.

name: 寻血猎犬
ability: 每局游戏限一次，在夜晚时*，你可以得知有多少名死亡的玩家与邪恶玩家邻座。
otherNightReminder: If the Bloodhound has not yet used their ability: the Bloodhound either nods or shakes their head. If the Bloodhound nods show the corresponding hand signal.

name: 通灵师
ability: 每局游戏限一次，在白天时，你可以私下询问说书人一个问题，你会得知该问题的多个答案，至少有一个答案是正确的。

name: 钟摆
ability: 如果与你邻近的一名存活玩家在夜晚死亡，你会得知与你邻近的另一名存活玩家的阵营。
otherNightReminder: If one of their alive neighbors dies at night, wake the Pendulum and give them a thumbs up or thumbs down.

name: 吹哨人
ability: 如果你在夜晚死亡，你会被唤醒，然后你要选择除你以外的三名玩家：你会得知你选中了哪些邪恶角色(或者你会得知没有)。
otherNightReminder: If the Whistleblower died tonight, they choose 3 players. Show them the character tokens of any evil characters they chose in any order, or show a 0.

name: 侍酒师
ability: 与你邻近的两名镇民之一醉酒。当你死于处决，你保留能力且说书人可以改为让另一名镇民玩家醉酒。
otherNightReminder: 如果侍酒师死于处决, 重新放置其醉酒标记。

name: 幻象
ability: 当你死亡时，恶魔可能会被当作善良阵营、镇民角色或外来者角色直到下个黄昏。
otherNightReminder: If the Phantom died, put the "Misregisters" reminder on the Demon.

name: 船夫
ability: 如果你已死亡且（除旅行者外）只有三名玩家存活，提名非恶魔的善良玩家死亡。

name: 呆瓜
ability: 当你得知你死亡时，你要公开选择一名存活的玩家：如果他是邪恶的，你的阵营落败。

name: 腐化者
ability: 有两名善良玩家可能会被当作邪恶的恶魔。在你的首个夜晚，他们会被唤醒得知此事，且你知道他们是谁。如果恶魔首次在夜晚死亡，你要选择他们之一变成邪恶的恶魔。
firstNightReminder: The Corruptor chooses 2 players: they learn they were chosen.
otherNightReminder: If the Demon died tonight, wake a corrupt player and tell them they are now any evil Demon. The Corruptor learns them.

name: 追踪者
ability: 一名善良玩家得知你在两名玩家之中。每个白天限一次，你可以公开猜测一名死亡的玩家得知了你在场，如果猜对，邪恶阵营获胜。如果你存活，善良阵营无法获胜。
firstNightReminder: Wake up the Prey and show them 2 players, one of which is the Seeker.

name: 回声使
ability: 每个夜晚，你要选择两名玩家（包括至少一名善良玩家）：明天第一名玩家要“疯狂”地证明第二名玩家的言论是正确的，不然他可能被处决。
firstNightReminder: The Echomancer chooses 2 players: they learn that the Echomancer chose them and who their echo is.
otherNightReminder: The Echomancer chooses 2 players: they learn that the Echomancer chose them and who their echo is.

name: 织命者
ability: 每个夜晚，你会得知恶魔当前选择哪一名玩家或哪一个角色是不利的。最后一个白天，获得最低票数的被提名的玩家会被处决，即使你已死亡。
firstNightReminder: Wake & show a player or character
otherNightReminder: Wake & show a player or character

name: 骸漩
ability: 每个夜晚*，你要选择一名玩家：他死亡。顺时针方向与你邻近的一名存活的镇民中毒：你知道他是谁。
firstNightReminder: Show the Necrowhirl which player they're poisoning.
otherNightReminder: The Necrowhirl points to a player. That player dies. If the poison has moved, show the poisoned player.

name: 瘴客
ability: 每个夜晚*，你要选择一名玩家：他死亡。当首名外来者死亡时，你要选择一个镇民角色：他中毒，即使你已死亡。[+1外来者]
otherNightReminder: The Xenotoxin points to a player. That player dies. If the first Outsider died today or tonight, the Xenotoxin chooses a character: they are poisoned.

name: 奥赫
ability: 每个夜晚*，你要选择一个角色：他死亡。如果该角色不在场，则由说书人来决定谁会被你杀死。
otherNightReminder: The Ojo points to a character. That character dies.

name: 亡骨魔
ability: 每个夜晚*，你要选择一名玩家：他死亡。被你杀死的爪牙保留他的能力，且与他邻近的两名镇民之一中毒。[-1外来者]
otherNightReminder: The Vigormortis points to a player. That player dies. If a Minion, they keep their ability and one of their Townsfolk neighbors is poisoned.
